newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco discusses water deal with foreign firms.
newsitem.headline: Morocco discusses water deal with foreign firms.

text.p: Morocco began talks with a Spanish-Portuguese consortium on a 30-year deal for management of water and electricity distribution in Rabat and three neighbouring cities, the official MAP news agency said on Monday.
Portuguese companies Pleiade and EDP and Spanish building company Dragados y Construcciones SA will team up in the project, said MAP.
Interior Minister Driss Basri had met representatives of the three companies to discuss the concession covering Rabat, Sale, Skhirat and Temara.
"The two sides agreed to pursue the study of the project with a view that a meeting would be held on February 17 in Rabat for a final decision on the offer made by the consortium," MAP said.
There was no figure immediately available on the amount involved in the deal.
